title: Retour des cendres
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Retour des cendres", at revision 1370900962, opens: "The retour des cendres was the return of the mortal remains of Napoleon I of France from the island of Saint Helena to France and the burial in Hôtel des Invalides in Paris in 1840, on the initiative of Prime Minister Adolphe Thiers and King Louis Philippe I." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q720483, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "return of Napoleon's mortal remains". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
